Precision Hits grant one stack of Meganeura for #e${3.5+#d} seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Precision Kills cause targets to explode, dealing <pve 123.89 /> <pvp [95.3] /> | <pve 173.6 /> <pvp [?] /> | <pve 207.57 /> <pvp [?] /> weapon-matching elemental damage in a 7.5-meter radius at 1|2|3| stacks.

Explosion has up to 50% damage falloff at the furthest point.
